ROMALANG 1: First Year Romanian First Quarter is the first course in a three quarter sequence. Focus on introducing Romanian in the context of formal and informal communication. Emphasis on topics of daily life activities and descriptions of self and community, short narratives, expression of feelings and simple questions and answers. Romanian culture is an essential part of the course.
ROMALANG 2: Continuation of ROMALANG 1. First Year Romanian Second Quarter is the second course in a three quarter sequence. Focus on further introducing Romanian in the context of formal and informal communication. Emphasis on topics of daily life activities and descriptions of self and community, short narratives, expression of feelings and simple questions and answers. Romanian culture is an essential part of the course. Prerequisite: ROMALANG 1 or placement test.
ROMALANG 3: Continuation of ROMALANG 2. First Year Romanian Third Quarter is the third course in a three quarter sequence. Focus on further introducing Romanian in the context of formal and informal communication. Emphasis on topics of daily life activities and descriptions of self and community, short narratives, expression of feelings and simple questions and answers. Romanian culture is an essential part of the course. Prerequisite: ROMALANG 2 or placement test. Completion of this course fulfills the University Language Requirement.
ROMALANG 21: Continuation of ROMALANG 3. Prerequisite: ROMALANG 3 or consent of instructor.
ROMALANG 22: Continuation of ROMALANG 21. Prerequisite: ROMALANG 21 or consent of instructor.
ROMALANG 23: Continuation of ROMALANG 22. Prerequisite: ROMALANG 22 or consent of instructor.
ROMALANG 395: Prerequisite: For Grad Students Only and Consent of Instructor
